meta.title: Review: Our Farewell Day
meta.textType: functional: a review of an event, a blog post

paragraphs: Posted by Lily. Did you come to Farewell Day? It was on Friday, March nineteenth, the last school day of Primary Six. Today is Saturday, March twentieth, and my holiday has started. Teacher Kim read this post first, and then it went online. We celebrated the end of the year with a play, games, a lunch, and a gift. This review gives stars to three parts of the day, and I give a reason for each star.

The play was at ten o'clock in the school hall. Many guests came, and the hall was full. The title was "The Missing Crown," and May wrote the story. Leo wore a clown hat, and Mia wore a cardboard police hat. A big police car stood on the stage. It was made from boxes and painted blue. In the story, a clown stole the crown, and the police car drove after him. Mia was excellent as the police officer, and she did not laugh once. The play gets four stars. The cardboard police car was funny, but the sound was too loud.

After the play, we went to the field for the games. The games started at eleven o'clock. The Explorers had the green flag with a paw print. We ran, we jumped, and we drank a lot of water. The sun was hot, so the games get three stars.

At noon, we had lunch in the school canteen. Chef Lucy, our cooking teacher, cooked the lunch. She made fried rice with egg, chicken, and green onions. It was delicious, especially with a little lime. The lunch gets five stars, because the fried rice was perfect. Leo had a small accident, and his fork fell on the floor. He took a new fork, and he said, "This is the best rice of the year."

At one o'clock, the gift was given to Teacher Kim. It was a wooden frame with our photo from the pond and a card. We all signed the card. Teacher Kim said, "Thank you. I will put it on my desk." Then Leo stood up and sang a short song like an opera singer. Everybody clapped, and Teacher Kim smiled.

Here are my stars. The play: four stars, because the car was funny, but the sound was too loud. The games: three stars, because the sun was hot. The lunch: five stars, because the fried rice was perfect. Which part of your last school day would you give three stars? Please tell us why in the comments.
